gate: STAGE B REQUIREMENT COMPLETENESS: IMPLEMENTED — READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
finding_addressed: Current validation can compare model-supplied requirements with model-supplied assessments without independently establishing that the requirement set is complete.

mechanism.name: Two-pass independent extraction
mechanism.description: Pass 1 extracts material requirements from the tender document bundle using a separate LLM call with no KB or company data. The output is the independently established requirement set. Pass 2 assesses the company against exactly that set. The validator enforces strict set equality between extracted and assessed requirements.

pass_1.validator: _validate_requirement_sources — verifies each requirement cites real document text

pass_2.input: tender documents + company KB + material_requirements from Pass 1

completeness_rules.description: Model requirements list must exactly match independent extraction (set equality, no duplicates)
completeness_rules.error: model requirements do not match independent extraction

completeness_rules.description: Assessments must exactly cover independent extraction (set equality, no missing, no orphans)
completeness_rules.error: assessments do not exactly cover independent requirements

completeness_rules.description: Each assessment must include the source evidence established in Pass 1
completeness_rules.error: assessment omitted independently established source evidence

completeness_rules.description: incomplete_inputs payload flag must match bundle flag
Unverified assessments with no company evidence must say 'no evidence on file'
completeness_rules.error: unsupported capability assessment must say no evidence on file

completeness_rules.description: Verdict must be derived deterministically from assessment statuses and gaps
completeness_rules.error: verdict does not follow requirement assessments and gaps

completeness_rules.description: Each requirement's tender_evidence must cite real document text at a real location
Requirement text must be non-empty and non-duplicate (case-insensitive)
completeness_rules.error: empty or duplicate independently extracted requirement

files_changed.description: Unit test matrix for completeness rules at the validator function boundary

files_unchanged.note: All completeness logic pre-existing; no modifications required
